title: A course with a familiar teacher
description: A course in sequence with a familiar teacher, easy to come back to after a break.

blocks.text: The connection with a teacher is made of their manner of explaining and a familiar approach. In a large library that connection gets lost among the new collections.

quote.text: I have used many of the major apps like Waking Up, HeadSpace, and Happier and while I've loved all those platforms and in many ways they introduced me to so many parts of the practice, what I found myself yearning for was more directed guidance on how to progressively improve or expand my practice.

blocks.text: Build the course around one author: a short explanation, a practice and a clear continuation. Keep repetition and a free choice of pace.
A long series of lessons does not make a course by itself. The transitions between sessions need testing, and the teacher should be available to listen to before buying.
